comparison.objective: Return all four surgical instruments from the drape to the tray so none remains; candidate recovers four fractured tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-object pickup and tray return versus tool-mediated notch fracture followed by millimetre-scale fragment search and recovery.
comparison.success_condition: All instruments on the tray and drape clear; numeric placement, stability, and damage rules are absent. Candidate additionally requires four contact-loaded fractures, unchanged inserts, no shell damage, and stable released tools.
comparison.reason: Complete item accounting and tray deposition overlap, but the candidate's defining tested ability is controlled fracture while protecting a retained coil; generic collection alone is insufficient for overlap.
